pages.title: Aleph Glass
pages.text: Glass whose clarity has a cardinality. It holds countably many points of light in a perfectly ordered grid, yet every sliver of it still contains as many points as the whole. Looking through it, scale stops meaning much.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Cantor showed some infinities are larger than others. In the ordinal lands I found panes of glass in which a small piece held just as many reflections as the whole. A one-to-one map onto itself.
Made in $(item)Formal Proof Assistant$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Transfinite Hierarchy.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Hopf Fibration, Ordinal Recursor, Power Set.
